name: Incline Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
research: Body, bench (30 deg), feet and spine copied unchanged from the proven incline_dumbbell_press (owner-approved, probe_bench passed). Its top pose elev 118 = a vertical arm, so the torso frame sits ~62 deg back from vertical: world up in torso = (0, sin62, cos62) = (0, 0.88, 0.47). Neutral handle must be horizontal and point toward the head, square to a vertical forearm: world +Y in torso = (0, -cos62, sin62) = [0, -0.47, 0.88]. Start elev 45 / plane -30 (10 deg more tucked than the prone press for palms-in), forearm vertical; end elev 118 / plane 88 as the proven press. S1 Rodriguez-Ridao 2020 (30 deg best for upper pec, ~45 deg abduction), S2 Muyor 2023 (neutral grip).
